Class AbstractMockMvcBuilder<B extends AbstractMockMvcBuilder<B>>

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvcBuilderSupport
org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup.AbstractMockMvcBuilder<B>
Type Parameters:
B - 构建器类型的自引用
All Implemented Interfaces:
MockMvcBuilder, ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder<B>
Direct Known Subclasses:
DefaultMockMvcBuilder, RouterFunctionMockMvcBuilder, StandaloneMockMvcBuilder
public abstract class AbstractMockMvcBuilder<B extends AbstractMockMvcBuilder<B>> extends MockMvcBuilderSupport implements ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder<B>
Abstract implementation of MockMvcBuilder with common methods for configuring filters, default request properties, global expectations and global result actions.

子类可以使用不同的策略来准备将传递给`DispatcherServlet` 的 Spring `WebApplicationContext`。

Since:
4.0
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev, Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen

    • addFilters

      public final <T extends B> T addFilters(jakarta.servlet.Filter... filters)
      描述从接口复制：ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder
      Add filters mapped to all requests. Filters are invoked in the same order.

      注意：如果您需要使用 `Filter.init(FilterConfig)` 来初始化过滤器，请使用 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder.addFilter(Filter, String, Map, EnumSet, String...) 代替。

      Specified by:
      addFilters 接口中的 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder<B extends AbstractMockMvcBuilder<B>>
      Parameters:
      filters - 要添加的过滤器

      Add a filter mapped to specific patterns.

      注意：如果您需要使用 `Filter.init(FilterConfig)` 来初始化过滤器，请使用 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder.addFilter(Filter, String, Map, EnumSet, String...) 代替。

      public <T extends B> T addFilter(jakarta.servlet.Filter filter, @Nullable String filterName, Map<String,String> initParams, EnumSet<jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType> dispatcherTypes, String... urlPatterns)
      描述从接口复制：ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder
      添加一个过滤器，该过滤器将通过 `Filter.init(FilterConfig)` 使用给定的初始化参数进行初始化，并且仅适用于匹配给定分发器类型和 URL 模式的请求。
      Specified by:
      addFilter 在接口 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder<B extends AbstractMockMvcBuilder<B>> 中
      Parameters:
      filter - 要添加的过滤器
      filterName - 用于过滤器的名称；如果为 null，则创建不带名称的MockFilterConfig，其名称默认为空字符串
      initParams - 用于初始化过滤器的初始化参数
      dispatcherTypes - 过滤器适用的分派器类型
      urlPatterns - 要映射的 URL 模式；如果为空，则匹配所有请求。

    • defaultRequest

      public final <T extends B> T defaultRequest(RequestBuilder requestBuilder)
      描述从接口复制：ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder
      Define default request properties that should be merged into all performed requests. In effect this provides a mechanism for defining common initialization for all requests such as the content type, request parameters, session attributes, and any other request property.

      执行请求时指定的属性将覆盖此处定义的默认属性。

      Specified by:
      `defaultRequest` 在接口 `ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder<B extends AbstractMockMvcBuilder<B>` 中。
      Parameters:
      requestBuilder - 一个 RequestBuilder；请参见静态工厂方法，位于 MockMvcRequestBuilders
